tests.title: Protocol mismatch and RequireLandlock refusals pass through unchanged, and a done ctx surfaces ctx.Err()
given: a podman provider over a fake runner seam
case A: the engine process serves a fakeagent whose Hello reports ProtocolMajor 99
case B: the engine process serves an agent whose Landlock report has ABI 0, with Spec.RequireLandlock true under NetworkNone
case C: the engine process never answers Hello and ctx is cancelled during Create
tests.when: Create is called in each case
then: case A: errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrProtocol) is true and no diagnostic run is recorded
case B: errors.As yields a *sandbox.SpecError with Field RequireLandlock and Provider podman
case C: errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) is true
every case records volume rm agentkit-<id>
tests.pseudocode:

its recipe runs go test -count=1 -v ./podman/ in sandbox/ with AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE and AGENTKIT_CONTAINER set as sandbox-images-test sets them
make -n check does not run sandbox-podman-test or ./podman/ with those variables
tests.pseudocode:
out = make("-n", "sandbox-podman-test"); assert contains(out, "go test -count=1 -v ./podman/") && contains(out, "AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE=")
assert prereqs("sandbox-podman-test") contains "sandbox-images"; assert !contains(make("-n", "check"), "sandbox-podman-test")

tests.title: examples/sandbox runs on podman with --podman and stays offline on local without it
given: examples/sandbox with its existing main_test.go
tests.when: go test ./... runs in examples/sandbox, and, with a real engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE set, go run . --podman --image $AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE runs
then: TS-13-68 and TS-14-45 in main_test.go pass unchanged
the --podman run exits 0 and prints "Sandbox example completed successfully"
the --podman part is skipped without an engine or the image variable
tests.pseudocode:
assert goTest("examples/sandbox").ok
if prereqOK: out, code = goRun("examples/sandbox", "--podman", "--image", img); assert code == 0 && contains(out, "Sandbox example completed successfully")

tests.title: An embedder runs a model's tools in a real container and gets the edits back, leaving nothing behind
given: a real podman or docker engine and the locally built base image in AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE (skipped otherwise)
a host source directory with src/main.go, a .gitignore excluding build/, and build/out.bin
tests.when: podman.New(Options{}) then Create(Spec{Image: base, Resources: {MemoryBytes: 256 << 20}}), Sync(LocalDir), Tools, proxy read_file, write_file and execute, Export to a temp LocalDir, and Close
then: every call succeeds and execute runs inside the container
the export holds the file written by write_file and no build/out.bin
after Close, ps -a and volume ls filtered on label agentkit.sandbox=<id> list nothing
tests.pseudocode:
p = podman.New(Options{}); s = p.Create(ctx, spec); s.Sync(ctx, LocalDir{src}); ts = s.Tools(ctx, opts)
call(ts, "read_file", {path:"src/main.go"}); call(ts, "write_file", {path:"new.txt", content:"x"}); call(ts, "execute", {command:"ls"})
s.Export(ctx, LocalDir{out}); assert exists(out+"/new.txt") && !exists(out+"/build/out.bin")
s.Close(ctx); assert engine("ps","-a","--filter","label=agentkit.sandbox="+id) == "" && engine("volume","ls","--filter","label=agentkit.sandbox="+id) == ""

tests.title: A public repository is cloned through the init container while the sandbox keeps no network
given: a real engine, AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE set and network access for the engine (skipped otherwise)
AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_GIT_URL or its default https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go
tests.when: a sandbox is created under NetworkNone, Sync(GitRepo{URL, Depth: 1}) runs before Tools, then Tools, a read_file of go.mod, an execute of bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/1.1.1.1/443', and a second GitRepo Sync
then: the GitRepo Sync returns a zero SyncResult and read_file returns the clone's go.mod
the TCP connect fails
the second GitRepo Sync returns an error containing "GitRepo must be the first Sync and come before Tools"
no agentkit-<id>-init container remains
tests.pseudocode:
r, err = s.Sync(ctx, GitRepo{URL: gitURL, Depth: 1}); assert err == nil && r == SyncResult{}
assert contains(call(ts, "read_file", {path:"go.mod"}).text, "module ")
assert !call(ts, "execute", {command: tcpConnect}).ok
_, err = s.Sync(ctx, GitRepo{URL: gitURL}); assert contains(err, "GitRepo must be the first Sync and come before Tools")

tests.title: Create with an image that has no agent reports ErrNoAgent with the copy line and leaves nothing behind
given: a real engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE (skipped otherwise)
a test image built locally as FROM <base>, USER root, RUN rm /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd, removed when the test ends
tests.when: Create is called with Spec{Image: <derived image>}
then: errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrNoAgent) is true and no Sandbox is returned
the message names /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd and contains a COPY --from= line from sandbox.OverlayCopyLine
ps -a and volume ls filtered on label agentkit.sandbox list no entry created by this Create
tests.pseudocode:
before = labelled(); _, err = p.Create(ctx, Spec{Image: noAgent}); assert errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrNoAgent) && contains(err, sandbox.AgentPath) && contains(err, "COPY --from=")
assert labelled() == before
real_components: the derived image without an agent

tests.title: A real sandbox created with a 5-second TTL and never closed disappears shortly after its TTL
given: a real engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE (skipped otherwise)
tests.when: Create is called with Spec{Image: base, TTL: 5s}, Close is never called, and the test polls for up to 35 seconds
then: ps -a and volume ls filtered on label agentkit.sandbox=<id> list nothing within 35 seconds of creation
Tools returns an error matching sandbox.ErrUnavailable or sandbox.ErrClosed
tests.pseudocode:
s = p.Create(ctx, Spec{Image: img, TTL: 5*time.Second}); eventually(35s, func() bool { return engineLabelled(id) == "" })
_, err = s.Tools(ctx, opts); assert errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrUnavailable) || errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrClosed)
real_components: the base image's agentkit-sandboxd and its --ttl

tests.title: Reap on a real engine removes an expired leftover volume and spares a future one
given: a real engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE (skipped otherwise)
volume agentkit-<id1> created with labels agentkit.sandbox=<id1> and agentkit.sandbox.expires one hour in the past
volume agentkit-<id2> created with labels agentkit.sandbox=<id2> and agentkit.sandbox.expires one hour in the future, removed at test end
tests.when: Reap(ctx) is called on podman.New(Options{})
then: the returned ids include id1 and exclude id2, and the error is nil
volume ls no longer lists agentkit-<id1>
volume ls still lists agentkit-<id2>
tests.pseudocode:
engine("volume","create","--label","agentkit.sandbox="+id1,"--label","agentkit.sandbox.expires="+past,"agentkit-"+id1); same for id2 with future
ids, err = p.Reap(ctx); assert err == nil && contains(ids, id1) && !contains(ids, id2)
assert !volumeExists("agentkit-"+id1) && volumeExists("agentkit-"+id2)
real_components: the podman or docker engine's ps, volume ls and inspect output
